- D13-PIN: CON-EM-007 <-> CON-EM-005 - D11 recorded the absence of a pin as a rule; D13 pins by evidence under the owner prompt (target 3); D11 evidence keeps its recorded identities
- ERR-001: AUTH-RUSTC-WASM64-DOC-D18 <-> AUTH-WASM-CORE-CHANGES-64 - rustc prose 'not standardized' vs Core Release 3.0 64-bit address space; bounded by the authority split (CON-RS-003)
- ERR-002: CON-WA-005 <-> CON-THREAD-001
- ERR-002: AUTH-WASM-JSAPI-STORAGE-D18 <-> AUTH-WASM-THREADS - agent-local JS embedding vs proposal shared memory
- ERR-003: AUTH-WASM-SET <-> AUTH-WASM-CORE-CHANGES-64 - proposal machinery vs current baseline
- OBS-D11-1: AUTH-IMPL-CHROMIUM-SWIFTSHADER-DOC-141 <-> AUTH-GPU-FALLBACK-ADAPTER - implementation doc says SwiftShader is a WebGL/GL fallback 'not intended for untrusted content'; the specification defines fallback adapters abstractly; neither says the SwiftShader WebGPU path is a hardware adapter

## Implementation behaviour (implementation truth, never standards law; Q20 has the three layers)

- IB-GPU-LINUX-SERVICE-OFF [PLATFORM_DEFAULT; runtime OBS] Chromium GPU service (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): on Linux the WebGPU service is disabled by default, so requestAdapter() answers null without switches; sources CL-IMP-GPU1; explains FACT-CAP-WEBGPU-EXPOSURE, FACT-GPU-ADAPTER-NULL-DEFAULT; stale if browser.flags: Chromium enables WebGPUService on Linux, or the launch switch set changes
- IB-GPU-UNSAFE-SWITCHES [FLAG_GATED; runtime OBS] Chromium GPU switches + Vulkan feature (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): FactTest's WebGPU adapter exists only under --enable-unsafe-webgpu, --enable-features=Vulkan, --use-angle=swiftshader, --enable-unsafe-swiftshader and --ignore-gpu-blocklist; every WebGPU admission is bound to that switch set; sources CL-IMP-GPU2, CL-IMP-GPU3, CL-IMP-GPU5, CL-IMP-GPU6, CL-IMP-GPU7; explains FACT-D24-BYTE-RELAY-EXECUTED, FACT-GPU-ADAPTER-SWIFTSHADER, FACT-GPU-ADMITTED-E0, FACT-GPU-KNOWN-ANSWER; stale if browser.flags: any switch of the set removed or renamed at another Chromium revision
- IB-GPU-SOFTWARE-FALLBACK [CONFORMS; runtime OBS] Chromium GPU config + Blink WebGPU + SwiftShader (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194; SwiftShader 7cd1022; Dawn 9caf493 (source unreachable)): under SwiftShader the WebGPU status is Software and the adapter is a CPU adapter, which Blink reports as isFallbackAdapter: no hardware GPU is involved; sources CL-IMP-DEPS2, CL-IMP-DEPS3, CL-IMP-GPU4, CL-IMP-GPU8, CL-IMP-GPU9; explains FACT-GPU-ADAPTER-SWIFTSHADER, FACT-HARDWARE-GPU-UNAVAILABLE; stale if host.gpu_device_node: a hardware adapter appears (GPU device node) or the SwiftShader/Dawn revisions change
- IB-SAB-CONSTRUCTOR-HOOK [HOST_CHOICE_PERMITTED; runtime OBS] Blink V8 initializer (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): the SharedArrayBuffer constructor is installed only where the context may transfer SharedArrayBuffers (cross-origin isolated); sources CL-IMP-SAB1, CL-IMP-SAB2; explains FACT-CAP-WASM-SHARED-THREADS-EXPOSURE, FACT-SAB-GLOBAL-HOST-DEFINED, FACT-SHARED-THREADS-UNADMITTED-D18; stale if origin_security.cross_origin_isolated: the page becomes cross-origin isolated or Chromium changes the hook
- IB-BLUETOOTH-PLATFORM-DEFAULT [PLATFORM_DEFAULT; runtime OBS] Blink runtime features (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): WebBluetooth is stable on Android/ChromeOS/iOS/Mac/Win but experimental by default elsewhere: absent on Linux; sources CL-IMP-BR1, CL-IMP-IDL5; explains FACT-CAP-BLUETOOTH-EXPOSURE; stale if browser.product: another platform or a flag enabling WebBluetooth
- IB-SENSOR-EXTRA-CLASSES [EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_SHIPPED; runtime OBS] Blink runtime features + sensor IDL (Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (9f043f63), headless shell rev 1194): Magnetometer and AmbientLightSensor are behind SensorExtraClasses (experimental); sources CL-IMP-BR2, CL-IMP-IDL1, CL-IMP-IDL2; explains FACT-CAP-AMBIENT-LIGHT-EXPOSURE, FACT-CAP-MAGNETOMETER-EXPOSURE, FACT-SENSOR-FAMILY-ADVISEMENT; stale if browser.flags: SensorExtraClasses enabled (flag) or shipped
